entities.name: Dichloro trifluoromethyl pyridine
observations: Reactant decoded as FC(F)(F)c1cnc(Cl)c(Cl)c1, an activated dichloropyridine bearing a trifluoromethyl group.

entities.name: 4-Chlorophenol
observations: Reactant decoded as Oc1ccc(Cl)cc1; its phenoxide is the nucleophile under carbonate base.

entities.name: Pyridyl chloride SNAr
observations: Base-promoted nucleophilic aromatic substitution replaces the pyridyl chloride adjacent to ring nitrogen with 4-chlorophenoxy; the second pyridyl chloride remains.

entities.name: SNAr product
observations: Predicted major product: 2-(4-chlorophenoxy)-3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridine, represented as FC(F)(F)c1cnc(Oc2ccc(Cl)cc2)c(Cl)c1.

entities.name: K2CO3 in DMSO
observations: Dip potassium carbonate functions as base and DMSO as solvent; neither is incorporated into the product.
